sourceFile: 84.BRS-2015 Report check function of vP after separate type VP 28.8.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source context but misidentifies the changed factor and cites headers instead of result rows.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not the tested VP NG/OK type condition.
Baseline and test conditions are left explicit as unknown despite table type-check groups.
Outcome evidence cites only header rows, not result rows 15,17,18,19 or decision row 24.
Outcome grouping duplicates the same result table and splits subheaders incorrectly.
Row-level keys such as date, line, sample number, and type check are not preserved.
requiredUserQuestions: Should OK(good) be treated as the reference condition and VP NG type checks as test conditions?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to VP type/check condition after separate VP NG/OK screening.
Define baseline/test groups from Type check rows or mark grouping ambiguous if not confirmed.
Attach result evidence to rows 15,17,18,19 and decision evidence to row 24.
Combine sigma and hearing submetrics under one function-check outcome table.
Preserve date, line, No, Type check, quantity, NG counts, NG rate, and note as subgroup/result fields.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current row citations are insufficient; cite data and decision rows, not only headers.
